New definitions are authorized by exact five reviewed SQL byte hashes; actual after-catalog hash is sealed in schema_config and reused as CAS at activation/verification. This is not a general DDL concurrency lock or independent reimplementation of PostgreSQL SQL semantics.
health: Reuse qualified25s total health budget, max1s probes, strict HTTP200/JSON ok:true, bounded body and two same PID/start snapshots. Keep actual Melamed min_uptime absent, Mor10000 and Ashraf5000; stability age is max5000/original policy. This is a stable-process window, not full async startup or authenticated workflow proof.
partialFailure: An immutable phase intent without result means STOP; do not retry blindly. Transport timeout is uncertain state, never permission to re-execute.

SQL file COMMIT and separate filename record are not atomic. If SQL succeeds and recording/next file fails, retain all private intent/result evidence and inspect actual schema/history before a reviewed reconciliation. Already applied files must not be replayed casually.

Schema/config may be prepared while incumbent process runs; source may be forwarded before restart; own restart may fail; another writer or CAS change may prevent conditional recovery. Each is a distinct inspected state.

The initial DB dump is verified recovery preservation, not permission for wholesale rollback. Forward source-tree plus owned-env recovery keeps additive schema/history and all rows. Fresh normal backupwatch remains a separate prerequisite.
Private recovery stage/pin and raw logs are retained after every failure. No cleanup or retry is automatic.
